## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## A Trusted Leader
## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

** Procurement

We find flexible, efficient solutions for our customers

food in 1885 and over the years have re-invented ourselves time and again to stay ahead of the
industry. That’s why our customers don’t just see us as order takers; they see us as success
makers.

# More Ways to
# help you make it

With top product portfolios, leading technology solutions and all-around flexibility, we're ready to
be your partner in the food business!

[ Become a customer ][137]
 

## MORE
## DELIVERIES

**Convenient. Dependable. Trackable.**

We're committed to making it easier for customers to get what they need, when they need it, with
greater flexibility and more responsive service through a range of delivery options.
  

[ How We Deliver ][138]
[ ][139]
[Scheduled ][140]

Quality products delivered with consistency.

[ ][141]
[Daily ][142]

Flexible delivery customized to meet your specific needs.

[ ][143]
[Delivered Via Parcel Carrier ][144]

New hard-to-find and specialty products, shipped directly to you.

## MORE
## QUALITY

An unmatched portfolio of quality products that consistently deliver on expectations.

[ Product we Offer ][145]
[ ][146]
[Exclusive Brands ][147]

Discover our premium, chef-inspired products crafted for quality and consistency.

[ ][148]
[Scoop ][149]

Explore innovative, trend-forward products designed to keep your menu fresh and exciting.

[ ][150]
[Switch + Savor ][151]

Save smart by switching to high-quality alternatives without compromising flavor.

## MORE
## TOOLS

From MOXē® to full suites of digital solutions such as CHECK® Business Tools and VITALS, we can help
you run your business with ease.

[ tools, tips & ideas ][152]
[ ][153]
[MOXē ][154]

Streamline operations with our industry-leading digital tools designed to simplify ordering and
inventory management.

[ ][155]
[CHECK Business Tools ][156]

Access powerful solutions to help you manage costs, labor, and profitability.

[ ][157]
[Menu Design ][158]

Create eye-catching menus that showcase your offerings and boost customer appeal.

[ ][159]
[VITALS ][160]

Stay informed with essential insights and resources to keep your business thriving.

## More solutions, across every industry

Our centralized systems and structure allow us to serve a variety of businesses with tools and
resources–
allowing you to maximize coverage and enable flexibility as you grow.

[ ][161]
[Restaurants ][162]

The specialists at US Foods® can help restaurant operators with industry-leading tools to build
their brand and bring in more diners. Find out more.

[ ][163]
[Regional Chains ][164]

US Foods® Operations Specialists can help retail food businesses grow their business and cut food
costs. Find out how here.

[ ][165]
[Healthcare ][166]

VITALS by US Foods® is a unique business and menu solutions program for healthcare operators facing
critical foodservice challenges. Learn more.

[ ][167]
[Hospitality ][168]

Whether a hotel, a banquet hall, a concert venue or a casino, if you're in the people business, US
Foods® is in your corner. Find out how here.

[ ][169]
[Education ][170]

The US Foods® Serve Good® program can help your dining service offer up the fresh, customizable and
healthy food that college students demand. Find out how now.

[ ][171]
[Retail ][172]

US Foods® Operations Specialists can help retail food businesses grow their business and cut food
costs. Find out how here.

[video image]

“What got me to become a US Foods customer was needing consistency, and consistency is what keeps me
as a customer. I was trying to grow a business, and now I'm able to grow even bigger with a company
like US Foods that can grow with me.”


Director of Operations | Carver 47

### Trending & Exclusive to US Foods®

[ ][173]
[Keep Your Kitchen One Step Ahead ][174]

You bring the heat, but so do market conditions. From weather to availability to changing demand,
operators are navigating more than ever. With the right partner, you can stay ready for whatever
comes next. US Foods® helps you adapt with confidence and keep your menu fired up.

Texas wildlife is as varied as the state itself – across deserts, mountains, forests, prairies,
rivers, and coastal marshes, Texas supports an extraordinary mix of animals and habitats.

Some species, such as the armadillo and Texas horned lizard, are closely tied to the state’s
identity, while others, including the whooping crane, Kemp’s ridley sea turtle, and ocelot, make

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

Categories [Animal Lists][68], [Birds][69]

# AFLECO

WE BRING PLANT BASED INGREDIENTS TO LIFE

Afleco is gespecialiseerd in aanbieden van plantaardige olie ingrediënten op een CO2 neutrale
manier. Dit doen wij in nauwe samenwerking met onze partners en dragen zo bij om onze ecologische
voetafdruk te minimaliseren. Het is [onze missie][13] om op deze wijze bij te dragen aan een
duurzame toekomst voor onze planeet.

 

Ontdek een partner die is gericht op een duurzame toekomst voor alle stakeholders, uw toekomst en
die van onze volgende generaties. Wij bieden u toegevoegde waarde en consistente kwaliteit door
actief mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en grenzen te verleggen.

 

Wat Afleco uniek maakt is onze onafhankelijkheid, het netwerk van specialisme die wij de afgelopen
decennia hebben vervaardigd en onze passie voor de producten die wij leveren.

[Startpagina productie.jpg]

## ONS ASSORTIMENT

Ons assortiment bestaat uit een aantal productcategorieën waarin wij gespecialiseerd zijn. Al onze
producten zijn toepasbaar in de Food-, Feed- en Oleochemicals industrieën en voldoen aan de hoogste
kwaliteitsstandaarden.



De voorkeuren van de consument veranderen voortdurend, maar wat constant blijft is het belang van
smaak, textuur en mondgevoel. In samenwerking met onze partners heeft Afleco de mogelijkheid tot de
essentiële procesinstallaties en R&D lab waarmee we klantspecifieke producten kunnen ontwikkelen.
Houd onze website daarom goed in de gaten en bekijk ons uitgebreide assortiment hieronder om te zien
wat wij aanbieden.


Als u nog vragen of speciale wensen heeft, neem dan contact met ons op. Wij helpen u graag verder.

[[Lecithine_BW.png]][14]

### [NATUURLIJKE EMULGATOREN][15]

De emulgatoren die wij aanbieden zijn afkomstig van natuurlijke plantaardige oliën zoals zonnebloem,
soja en koolzaad. Zij verbinden water met olie om de perfecte emulsie te creëren. Tevens kunnen wij
producten aanbieden gekenmerkt als biologische emulgator welke tot stand komen door koude pers
technieken. Tijdens het extractieproces wordt geen gebruik gemaakt van chemische oplosmiddelen.
Onder het assortiment van ons merk [DeliLec ][16]worden de diverse natuurlijke emulgatoren
aangeboden.

 

De producten in het [DeliLec][17] assortiment hebben uitstekende vloeibare eigenschappen en zijn
uitermate geschikt voor in de margarine, chocolade, banketbakkerij en cosmetica. Vanwege de hoge
voedingswaarde is het eveneens uitermate geschikt om te gebruiken in diervoeder.


[Meer informatie][18]
[[Flake_BW.png]][19]

### [FLAKES][20]

[DeliFlake][21] is ons merk dat een breed scala van toepasbaarheid kent. Flakes zijn handig in
gebruik doordat er gemakkelijk relatief kleine hoeveelheden mee kunnen worden gedoseerd en hebben
een lange houdbaarheid tot twee jaar voor traditionele flakes.



Typische eigenschappen van flakes zijn het zeer stabiele kristallennetwerk, het gemakkelijk mengen
en verspreiden zonder klontvorming. Door de samenwerking met onze partners hebben wij de
mogelijkheid om klantspecifieke flakes te maken en te voorzien van natuurlijke ingrediënten zoals
vitamines, emulgatoren, smaakstoffen en natuurlijke kleurstoffen.

[Meer informatie][22]
[[Powder_BW.png]][23]

### [POEDERS][24]

Poeders zijn ideaal om te mengen met andere poedervormige ingrediënten. Doordat de producten
dezelfde structuur hebben mengt dit eenvoudig tot een homogeen mengsel. Ook zijn poeders zeer
geschikt om een dun laagje van poedervet over uw product te doseren.


Wij kunnen u diverse verschillende poeder varianten aanbieden onder ons merk [DeliPow. ][25]

[Meer informatie][26]
[[Red oil_BW.png]][27]

### [NATUURLIJKE COLOURANT][28]

Een 100% natuurlijke kleurstof en antioxidant vervaardigd uit de meest verse trossen palmolie die
binnen enkele uren op een milde wijze worden verwerkt. Door deze wijze van oogsten en verwerken
blijft de olie rijk aan carotenoïden, waaronder bètacaroteen, tocoferolen en tocotriënolen.



[DeliRed][29] is ons merk en sluit perfect aan bij de groeiende vraag van de consument naar
natuurlijke ingrediënten en clean labeling. [DeliRed][30] is uitermate geschikt voor margarine,
mayonaise, sauzen, wok olie, snacks, en bakkerij producten om zo uw product kleur te geven én
oxidatie tegen te gaan waardoor uw product langer vers blijft.



[Meer informatie][31]
[Schermafbeelding 2022-08-03 om 22.32.32.png]

## CONTACT

blijft de olie rijk aan carotenoïden, waaronder bètacaroteen, tocoferolen en tocotriënolen.

natuurlijke ingrediënten en clean labeling. [DeliRed][30] is uitermate geschikt voor margarine,
mayonaise, sauzen, wok olie, snacks, en bakkerij producten om zo uw product kleur te geven én
oxidatie tegen te gaan waardoor uw product langer vers blijft.

## Our Global Export Market

## Our Business

Apical Group is a leading vegetable oil processor with an expanding global footprint. Our vertically
integrated mid-stream refining and value-added downstream processing makes us an integral supplier
that supports the food, feed, oleochemicals and renewable fuel needs across industries.

Download our [brochures][51] to find our more about our products.

##### Oleochemicals

Our portfolio includes a wide range of oleochemicals such as fatty acid, soap noodles, glycerin, and
more.

##### Functional & Specialty Fats


We deliver a range of quality edible oils and its derivatives used by consumer goods manufacturers
globally for food and non-food applications.

##### Renewable Fuel

We produce biodiesel through the processing of palm oil at our facilities.

##### Circular Economy

### Our Products

Our vertically integrated operations allow us to produce a high standard of innovative products for
our customers. The benefits are competitive prices, consistent supply, product quality and
customised solutions.

[Explore our full product range][52]

### Responsible Sourcing & Production

For improved agricultural practices, we identify priority suppliers to engage with. We are also
committed to producing high quality palm oil products efficiently, safely and responsibly in our
internationally certified refineries.

[Find out more][53]

## Our Sustainability Approach

Sustainability is inherent to the way we think, act and operate. Responsible practices within our
operations and supply chain is essential for our long-term success as we head towards a circular
economy and 2030. Our approach is guided by our 5Cs business philosophy of doing what is good for
the community, country, climate, customer and only then will it be good for the company.

[Join us on our sustainability transformation journey][54]

Di Apical Group, komitmen kami terhadap keberlanjutan berasal dari tingkat pimpinan tertinggi.
Presiden Apical didukung oleh Direktur Keberlanjutan dan berbagai pimpinan unit bisnis untuk
memastikan bahwa keberlanjutan terintegrasi dalam unit bisnis dan fungsional, serta tertanam dalam
nilai dan inisiatif utama perusahaan.

Topik keberlanjutan dibahas dalam rapat Dewan Direksi yang diadakan setiap kuartal. Kami juga
memiliki tim Keberlanjutan khusus yang berbasis di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, serta di Pekanbaru,
Dumai, Medan, Jakarta, dan Balikpapan di Indonesia. Tim Keberlanjutan bertugas untuk melaksanakan
dan memantau komitmen kami melalui keterlibatan dan kolaborasi konstruktif dengan para pemangku
kepentingan.

Selain itu, terdapat departemen Sosial, Keamanan, dan Perizinan (SSL) di setiap kilang yang kami
miliki, yang menangani urusan sosial dan perizinan sesuai dengan peraturan nasional serta Kebijakan
Keberlanjutan Apical. Tim ini juga mengawasi program Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (CSR) untuk
mendukung peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Mewujudkan tujuan keberlanjutan memerlukan lebih dari sekadar kolaborasi dengan para pemangku
kepentingan utama kami. Kolaborasi lintas industri dan dengan perusahaan sejenis juga sangat
penting, oleh karena itu kami terus mencari dan berpartisipasi dalam kemitraan baru, keanggotaan
industri yang relevan, serta skema sertifikasi.

Kami berpartisipasi dalam keanggotaan industri dan skema sertifikasi seperti Tropical Forest
Alliance 2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) — termasuk RSPO P&C Review Taskforce dan
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), serta Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

At Apical Group, our commitment to sustainability stems right from the top. Apical’s President is
supported by the Director of Sustainability and various business heads, to ensure sustainability is
integrated within business and functional units, and embedded in the company’s core values and
initiatives.

Sustainability topics are discussed at Board meetings held quarterly. We also have dedicated
Sustainability teams based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Pekanbaru, Dumai, Medan, Jakarta and
Balikpapan in Indonesia. The Sustainability teams are tasked with implementing and monitoring our
commitments through constructive stakeholder engagement and collaboration.

In addition, there is also a dedicated Social, Security and Licensing (SSL) department in each
refinery we own, to handle social and licensing matters in compliance with national regulations as
well as the Apical Sustainability Policy. The team also oversees Corporate Social Responsibility
(CSR) programmes to support better livelihoods in local communities.

Achieving sustainability goals requires more than just collaboration with our key stakeholders.
Collaboration across industries and peer companies are also crucial and hence, we constantly look
for and participate in new partnerships, relevant industry membership and certification schemes.

We participate in industry membership and certification schemes such as the Tropical Forest Alliance
2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), including the RSPO P&C Review Taskforce and the
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, the International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), and the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

## Our Business

Apical Group is a leading vegetable oil processor with an expanding global footprint. Our vertically
integrated mid-stream refining and value-added downstream processing makes us an integral supplier
that supports the food, feed, oleochemicals and renewable fuel needs across industries.

Download our [brochures][51] to find our more about our products.

##### Oleochemicals

Our portfolio includes a wide range of oleochemicals such as fatty acid, soap noodles, glycerin, and
more.

##### Functional & Specialty Fats


We deliver a range of quality edible oils and its derivatives used by consumer goods manufacturers
globally for food and non-food applications.

##### Renewable Fuel

We produce biodiesel through the processing of palm oil at our facilities.

##### Circular Economy

### Our Products

Our vertically integrated operations allow us to produce a high standard of innovative products for
our customers. The benefits are competitive prices, consistent supply, product quality and
customised solutions.

[Explore our full product range][52]

### Responsible Sourcing & Production

For improved agricultural practices, we identify priority suppliers to engage with. We are also
committed to producing high quality palm oil products efficiently, safely and responsibly in our
internationally certified refineries.

[Find out more][53]

## Our Sustainability Approach

Sustainability is inherent to the way we think, act and operate. Responsible practices within our
operations and supply chain is essential for our long-term success as we head towards a circular
economy and 2030. Our approach is guided by our 5Cs business philosophy of doing what is good for
the community, country, climate, customer and only then will it be good for the company.

[Join us on our sustainability transformation journey][54]

Di Apical Group, komitmen kami terhadap keberlanjutan berasal dari tingkat pimpinan tertinggi.
Presiden Apical didukung oleh Direktur Keberlanjutan dan berbagai pimpinan unit bisnis untuk
memastikan bahwa keberlanjutan terintegrasi dalam unit bisnis dan fungsional, serta tertanam dalam
nilai dan inisiatif utama perusahaan.

Topik keberlanjutan dibahas dalam rapat Dewan Direksi yang diadakan setiap kuartal. Kami juga
memiliki tim Keberlanjutan khusus yang berbasis di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, serta di Pekanbaru,
Dumai, Medan, Jakarta, dan Balikpapan di Indonesia. Tim Keberlanjutan bertugas untuk melaksanakan
dan memantau komitmen kami melalui keterlibatan dan kolaborasi konstruktif dengan para pemangku
kepentingan.

Selain itu, terdapat departemen Sosial, Keamanan, dan Perizinan (SSL) di setiap kilang yang kami
miliki, yang menangani urusan sosial dan perizinan sesuai dengan peraturan nasional serta Kebijakan
Keberlanjutan Apical. Tim ini juga mengawasi program Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (CSR) untuk
mendukung peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Mewujudkan tujuan keberlanjutan memerlukan lebih dari sekadar kolaborasi dengan para pemangku
kepentingan utama kami. Kolaborasi lintas industri dan dengan perusahaan sejenis juga sangat
penting, oleh karena itu kami terus mencari dan berpartisipasi dalam kemitraan baru, keanggotaan
industri yang relevan, serta skema sertifikasi.

Kami berpartisipasi dalam keanggotaan industri dan skema sertifikasi seperti Tropical Forest
Alliance 2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) — termasuk RSPO P&C Review Taskforce dan
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), serta Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

At Apical Group, our commitment to sustainability stems right from the top. Apical’s President is
supported by the Director of Sustainability and various business heads, to ensure sustainability is
integrated within business and functional units, and embedded in the company’s core values and
initiatives.

Sustainability topics are discussed at Board meetings held quarterly. We also have dedicated
Sustainability teams based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Pekanbaru, Dumai, Medan, Jakarta and
Balikpapan in Indonesia. The Sustainability teams are tasked with implementing and monitoring our
commitments through constructive stakeholder engagement and collaboration.

In addition, there is also a dedicated Social, Security and Licensing (SSL) department in each
refinery we own, to handle social and licensing matters in compliance with national regulations as
well as the Apical Sustainability Policy. The team also oversees Corporate Social Responsibility
(CSR) programmes to support better livelihoods in local communities.

Achieving sustainability goals requires more than just collaboration with our key stakeholders.
Collaboration across industries and peer companies are also crucial and hence, we constantly look
for and participate in new partnerships, relevant industry membership and certification schemes.

We participate in industry membership and certification schemes such as the Tropical Forest Alliance
2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), including the RSPO P&C Review Taskforce and the
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, the International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), and the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

## About The BHGS                                                                                  
                                                                                                   
[Picture]                                                                                          
The BHGS (British Historical Games Society) is your gateway into the plethora of events, rankings  
and links to wargaming sites across the world.                                                     
                                                                                                   
We are  here primarily to organise a number of multi-ruleset wargaming tournaments across the UK,  
and be a source of information everyone involved in the world of wargaming. Even genres which do   
not fall into the 'historical' genres are welcomed at our events which regularly include fantasy   
and science fiction themed competitions.                                                           
                                                                                                   
If you are new - or returning - to the hobby, you may want to check out our [Introduction to       
Tabletop Wargaming][44] page, or our list of [Wargaming Clubs][45] to find a group of like-minded  
friendly gamers near you.                                                                          
                                                                                                   
As with everything we do at the BHGS we welcome feedback and questions appertaining to everything  
we do - so please use the contact page to ensure a response from the relevant committee member.    
                                                                                                   
We look forward to welcoming you to one of our events soon.                                        
                                                                                                   
The BHGS Committee                                                                                 
                                                                                                   
(The BHGS is also on [Facebook][46] and [Twitter (aka "X") ][47] Make sure to "Like" or "Follow"   
 ***The BHGS***  for regular updates, and to see which of your friends are attending our events)   
[ Join our Mailing List to get updates on our events ][48]                                         
Signing up for our mailiing list or entering one of our events is treated as an "opt-in" to our    
email list under European GDPR regulations. We generally send out fewer than half a dozen or so    
emails each year to inform list members about upcoming gaming events. Information you provide (i.e.
which rulesets you tell us you play, or which you enter at one of our events) is included on your  
profile so we can send you fewer emails (i.e. we may send emails about events for a particular     
ruleset only to people who play that set). You can [unsubscribe][49] at any time via that link.    
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────────────
*Original graphic design by Nobby*                  
Copyright The BHGS                                  
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## About The BHGS                                                                                  
                                                                                                   
[Picture]                                                                                          
The BHGS (British Historical Games Society) is your gateway into the plethora of events, rankings  
and links to wargaming sites across the world.

# Jedwards International, Inc.

Wholesale Supplier of Bulk Raw Materials and Bulk Ingredients

Jedwards International, Inc. is a wholesale supplier of bulk natural oils, raw materials, and
ingredients at competitive wholesale prices. Sourcing raw materials from quality manufacturers
globally, we offer an extensive product portfolio consisting of Fair Trade, Sustainable, USP, RSPO,
Kosher, and Organic certified ingredients.

## More About Jedwards…

## Whom We Serve

Since our founding, our mission has been to be the go-to bulk wholesale supplier of natural,
organic, and specialty raw materials for companies servicing multiple industries. **Personal Care,
Soapmaking, Cosmetic, Specialty Food, Candle Making,** and **Aromatherapy**—each with their own
challenges and requirements—are just a few of the industries Jedwards supports.

[Contact Us][221]

## Why Choose Jedwards?

Jedwards International, Inc. is a family-owned business approaching a 100-year tradition of
supplying wholesale specialty ingredients. Our origins were in the import and distribution of
Omega-3 Fish Oils and Cod Liver Oil to Dietary Supplement producers. We have since evolved to
specialize in **supplying difficult-to-source Bulk Specialty Ingredients to small and mid-sized
companies and contract manufacturers across North America.**

As an established distributor, we proudly focus on Specialty Marine and Plant-based Oils and have
developed long-standing partnerships across the globe. With inventory maintained in our own
custom-built, geothermal facility south of Boston, **Jedwards is well-positioned to adapt to supply
chain challenges and disruptions as they arise for our bulk naturals and essentials portfolio.**

## More About Jedwards…

## Whom We Serve

Since our founding, our mission has been to be the go-to bulk wholesale supplier of natural,
organic, and specialty raw materials for companies servicing multiple industries. **Personal Care,
Soapmaking, Cosmetic, Specialty Food, Candle Making,** and **Aromatherapy**—each with their own
challenges and requirements—are just a few of the industries Jedwards supports.

[Contact Us][221]

## Why Choose Jedwards?

Jedwards International, Inc. is a family-owned business approaching a 100-year tradition of
supplying wholesale specialty ingredients. Our origins were in the import and distribution of
Omega-3 Fish Oils and Cod Liver Oil to Dietary Supplement producers. We have since evolved to
specialize in **supplying difficult-to-source Bulk Specialty Ingredients to small and mid-sized
companies and contract manufacturers across North America.**

As an established distributor, we proudly focus on Specialty Marine and Plant-based Oils and have
developed long-standing partnerships across the globe. With inventory maintained in our own
custom-built, geothermal facility south of Boston, **Jedwards is well-positioned to adapt to supply
chain challenges and disruptions as they arise for our bulk naturals and essentials portfolio.**

Jedwards International, Inc. is a family-owned business with an almost 100-year tradition of
supplying wholesale specialty ingredients. Our origins were in the import and distribution of
Omega-3 Fish Oils and Cod Liver Oil for use by Dietary Supplement producers. Since then, we have
come to **specialize in servicing the unique needs of a variety of small and mid-sized companies and
contract manufacturers** across North America with a range of difficult to source Bulk Specialty
Ingredients, with a particular focus on Specialty Marine and Plant-based Oils.

As an established distributor that has developed long-standing partnerships across the globe and
maintains inventory warehoused in our own custom-built geothermal facility, **Jedwards is
well-positioned to adapt to supply chain challenges and disruptions as they occur.**

### Frequently Asked Questions

What is Supply Chain Finance?

Any private or public entity is eligible to avail supply chain finance. Sole proprietorship and
partnership companies can also use this facility. Supply chain finance is like a high-tech helper
for businesses that makes deals smoother, hassle-free, and more cost-effective. It's a set of smart
processes using technology to bring down expenses and make things work better for everyone in a
business deal. It’s like a tool that helps buyers and sellers in a transaction save money and do
things faster.

What are the Documents Required for Supply Chain Finance?

The documents required for supply chain finance is as follows:
* Identity proof
* Address proof
* Financial documents
* Business ownership documents.

What are the Types of trading services offered under Supply Chain Finance?

The Types of trading services offered under Supply Chain Finance are as follows:
* Invoice Discounting
* Dynamic Discounting
* Supply Chain Financing Platforms
* Receivables Finance
* Payables Financing
* Inventory Financing
* Purchase Order Financing
* Channel Financing

What is the Eligibility Criteria for Supply Chain Finance?

To be able to avail of supply chain financing, the eligibility criteria is as follows:
* Creditworthiness
* Indian Nationality
* Business Vintage of at least 3 years
* Transaction Volume
* Trade Relationship
* Invoices and Receivables
* Supply Chain Visibility
* Compliance
* Financial Health
* A good CIBIL score

What is the Interest Rates for Supply Chain Finance?

There’s no one fixed rate of interest for supply chain finances. It depends on several factors like
the provider, companies trustworthiness, creditworthiness, market conditions, and more. The interest
rate is mostly competitive in nature.

How can one apply for Supply Chain Finance?
* Step 1: Login to our website https://www.credlix.com/
* Step 2: Give all the necessary information required.
* Step 3: Go through the eligibility criteria thoroughly.
* Step 4: Agree on the financing terms with Credlix.
* Step 5: The final approval.

What are the Features & Benefits of Supply Chain Finance?

Features and benefits of supply chain finance:
* Good working capital and cash flow
* Better inventory management.
* Good returns
* Low cost
* Digital, fast, and safe process
* Up to 90% of invoices financed
* No-collateral is required

Who all can avail Supply Chain Finance?

Any private or public entity is eligible to avail supply chain finance. Sole proprietorship and
partnership companies can also use this facility.

What is the repayment tenor of supply chain finance?

The repayment tenor of supply chain finance is 12 months. As per the business requirements, it can
also be extended.

What are the types of SME loans for supply chain finance?

The four common types of SME loans for supply chain finance are invoice financing, purchase order
financing, supply chain financing, and inventory financing.

How is the interest rate calculated and finalized by the company providing supply chain finance?

The supply chain finance company calculates the interest rate based on how much of the credit limit
the client has used up.

How many limits can a business avail from supply chain finance?

A business can receive up to 80% to 85% of the total value of the invoice. It also depends on the
specific requirements and eligibility criteria set by the supply chain finance company.

# We represent the leading fishmeal and fish oil-producing nations across Europe, working to sustain
# and grow the blue value chain, achieve circularity in the blue economy, and ensure its vital
# contribution to the global food supply, all while promoting sustainable practices.


**EFFOP – Marine Nutrients Europe: Supporting a Sustainable Global Aquaculture Industry**

We proudly represent the European fishmeal and fish oil producers across **Denmark, the Faroe
Islands, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Estonia, Latvia, Finland,
Malta, and Spain**. Our industry plays a critical role in supporting the global aquaculture sector,
helping to feed the world with healthy, sustainable fish products.

 

**Key Facts About Our Industry:**
* – Annually, EFFOP members produce around **600,000 tonnes of fishmeal and 190,000 tonnes of fish
  oil **(average 2020-2024).
* – The estimated total production value in 2024 is approximately **€2 billion**.
* – European fishmeal and fish oil are made from sustainable fish stocks, subject to **strict
  governmental regulations and biological advice **on total allowable catches (TACs).
* – The raw materials primarily consist of **small, oily, short-lived species** (e.g., blue whiting,
  capelin, sand eel, Norway pout, sprat) and **trimmings from fish processing**.
* – Around **36% of the raw materials derive from trimmings**, optimizing the use of marine
  resources.
* – The sector supports **international standards and certifications**, including MarinTrust and
  MSC, and adheres to the FAO code of conduct for responsible fisheries.
* – Fishmeal and fish oil are critical in feeds for aquaculture, pigs, and chickens, with
  **aquaculture being the largest consumer**.
* – Nutritional benefits include high protein content, rich omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA),
  essential amino acids, and important vitamins and minerals.
* – Fishmeal and fish oil have a **low carbon footprint** compared to other feed ingredients.

 

Our members, representing all major fishmeal and fish oil-producing nations in Europe, ensure that
the blue value chain continues to thrive, contributing significantly to the sustainable growth of
the global food supply.

Find more details about the European fishmeal and fish oil production in our [**Factsheet**][40].

# We represent the leading fishmeal and fish oil-producing nations across Europe, working to sustain
# and grow the blue value chain, achieve circularity in the blue economy, and ensure its vital
# contribution to the global food supply, all while promoting sustainable practices.


**EFFOP – Marine Nutrients Europe: Supporting a Sustainable Global Aquaculture Industry**

We proudly represent the European fishmeal and fish oil producers across **Denmark, the Faroe
Islands, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Estonia, Latvia, Finland,
Malta, and Spain**. Our industry plays a critical role in supporting the global aquaculture sector,
helping to feed the world with healthy, sustainable fish products.

 

**Key Facts About Our Industry:**
* – Annually, EFFOP members produce around **600,000 tonnes of fishmeal and 190,000 tonnes of fish
  oil **(average 2020-2024).
* – The estimated total production value in 2024 is approximately **€2 billion**.
* – European fishmeal and fish oil are made from sustainable fish stocks, subject to **strict
  governmental regulations and biological advice **on total allowable catches (TACs).
* – The raw materials primarily consist of **small, oily, short-lived species** (e.g., blue whiting,
  capelin, sand eel, Norway pout, sprat) and **trimmings from fish processing**.
* – Around **36% of the raw materials derive from trimmings**, optimizing the use of marine
  resources.
* – The sector supports **international standards and certifications**, including MarinTrust and
  MSC, and adheres to the FAO code of conduct for responsible fisheries.
* – Fishmeal and fish oil are critical in feeds for aquaculture, pigs, and chickens, with
  **aquaculture being the largest consumer**.
* – Nutritional benefits include high protein content, rich omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA),
  essential amino acids, and important vitamins and minerals.
* – Fishmeal and fish oil have a **low carbon footprint** compared to other feed ingredients.

 

Our members, representing all major fishmeal and fish oil-producing nations in Europe, ensure that
the blue value chain continues to thrive, contributing significantly to the sustainable growth of
the global food supply.

Find more details about the European fishmeal and fish oil production in our [**Factsheet**][40].

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity

  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

### **Biocarburants, bio-tickets, e-tickets, et matières premières**

Nous sommes spécialisés dans le **courtage de biocarburants** de deuxième génération, issus de
matières premières résiduelles ([huiles de cuisson usagées][43], [graisses animales CAT1/2][44],
[graisses animales CAT3 ][45]déchets industriels).

2.15.0.0

innovantes dans le domaine des énergies renouvelables.

## Notre accompagnement
## et nos solutions énergétiques

2.15.0.0
2.15.0.0

[Biocarburants][41], électricité renouvelable, hydrogène, biogaz, BioGNL, [SAF][42]… Les solutions
**énergétiques alternatives** sont nombreuses. Greenea propose de vous guider sur le chemin de la
**décarbonation** grâce à son savoir-faire et son expérience en conseil et courtage.

2.15.0.0
2.15.0.0

### **Biocarburants, bio-tickets, e-tickets, et matières premières**

Nous sommes spécialisés dans le **courtage de biocarburants** de deuxième génération, issus de
matières premières résiduelles ([huiles de cuisson usagées][43], [graisses animales CAT1/2][44],
[graisses animales CAT3 ][45]déchets industriels).

Nous intervenons également dans la **commercialisation de bio-tickets** (TIRUERT, CATF, IRICC, KVO,
THG, HBO, RED),en apportant une transparence complète sur les prix des certificats RED, afin
d’**optimiser vos transactions**.

[Voir les produits][46]
[Image d'illustration Greenea]

### **Certificats d’économies d’énergie (CEE) et crédit carbone**

En tant que courtier, nous jouons un rôle d’intermédiaire stratégique entre les entités réalisant
des travaux de **rénovation énergétique** et les « obligés », entreprises tenues de respecter les
obligations d’économies d’énergie.

Notre expertise couvre la sélection de partenaires pour l’**achat de CEE**, ainsi que la négociation
commerciale, assurant à nos clients des conditions optimales sur le marché.

Nous agissons aussi bien sur le **marché primaire que secondaire des CEE**, que ce soit pour des
ventes ponctuelles ou la mise en place de contrats annuels, adaptés à vos besoins

[Voir les produits][47]
[Recharge d'une voiture électrique - Image d'illustration Greenea]

### **Certificats GO / EAC & Contrats PPA**

Chez Greenea, nous accompagnons les entreprises dans l’achat, la gestion et la traçabilité des
**certificats numériques GO/EAC**, garantissant que l’électricité consommée provient de sources
d’énergie renouvelable.

Nous offrons également un soutien personnalisé dans la recherche, la négociation et la gestion de
**contrats d’achat d’électricité **(PPA) adaptés aux besoins spécifiques de chaque entreprise,
assurant ainsi une transition énergétique efficace et optimisée.

[Voir les produits][48]

### **Service de conseil**
### **et d’accompagnement**
### **en stratégie climat & carbone**

 

À chaque mission son approche personnalisée ! Forts de notre **expertise des marchés** et de nos
compétences variées (élaboration de business plans, analyse de marché, prévisions financières,
analyse et prévision des prix…), nous vous accompagnons dans l’élaboration de votre stratégie
d’investissement dans les filières des carburants alternatifs.

2.15.0.0
[Image d'illustration Greenea]

fournisseurs : industries du biocarburant et raffineries de pétrole, centrales électriques de
biomasses et sociétés de trading.

# HyperText Transfer Protocol (HTTP)

HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) is the foundation of data exchange on the web. Every web page,
API call, image, stylesheet, and script reaches its destination through HTTP. Clients send requests
to servers, servers return responses, and intermediaries like proxies and CDNs relay messages
between them.

HTTP is part of the internet protocol suite alongside DNS, TLS, and TCP.

This page was delivered over HTTP

Every web page, including this one, reaches the browser through an HTTP request and response.

## How HTTP works

HTTP follows a request-response model. A client sends a request specifying an [HTTP method][7] (the
action), a [URL][8] (the resource), and [Headers][9] (metadata). The server processes the request
and returns a response with a [status code][10] (the outcome), headers, and an optional body
containing the resource data.

`GET /api/products HTTP/1.1
Host: www.example.re
Accept: application/json
`

`HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 512

{"products":[...]}
`

HTTP is [stateless by design][11]: each request is self-contained and independent. [Cookies][12] and
[tokens][13] maintain state across exchanges when needed.

## HTTP versions

The [original HTTP specification][14] dates to the early 1990s with a single-line protocol
supporting only [GET][15] requests. Each subsequent version addressed the performance and security
limitations of its predecessor.
* **[HTTP/1.0][16]**: added [HTTP headers][17], [HTTP status codes][18], and content types beyond
  HTML. Each request opened a new TCP connection.
* **[HTTP/1.1][19]**: made persistent [HTTP connections][20] the default, allowing multiple
  request-response exchanges over a single TCP connection.
* **[HTTP/2][21]**: introduced binary framing, multiplexing, and header [Compression][22]. Multiple
  HTTP requests and HTTP responses flow concurrently over one connection.
* **[HTTP/3][23]**: replaced TCP with [QUIC][24], a UDP-based transport with built-in encryption
  eliminating head-of-line blocking.

## Core components

HTTP relies on three core building blocks working together in every exchange:
* **[HTTP headers][25]**: name-value pairs carrying metadata about the message, the client, and the
  server. Headers control [HTTP caching][26], [Authentication][27], [Compression][28], [content
  negotiation][29], [session state][30], and security policy.
* **[HTTP methods][31]**: verbs defining the action on a resource. [GET][32] retrieves, [POST][33]
  submits, [PUT][34] replaces, [DELETE][35] removes. Each method carries safety, idempotency, and
  [cacheability][36] properties.
* **[HTTP status codes][37]**: three-digit numbers in the response indicating the outcome. [1xx][38]
  informational, [2xx][39] success, [3xx][40] [redirection][41], [4xx][42] client error, [5xx][43]
  server error.

## Security

Plain HTTP transmits data in cleartext. [HTTPS][44] layers HTTP over TLS, encrypting the exchange
and providing confidentiality, integrity, and server authentication. [HSTS][45] enforces [HTTPS][46]
for all future connections to a host. Modern browsers mark plain HTTP pages as insecure and restrict
sensitive APIs to secure contexts.

To coordinate between clients, servers, and intermediaries, HTTP relies on:
* **[CORS][47]**: controls which [origins][48] are permitted to read responses from a different
  origin. Servers declare allowed origins, methods, and headers through response headers.
* **[Content Security Policy (CSP)][49]**: restricts the sources a page loads scripts, styles,
  images, and other resources from. A strong CSP blocks cross-site scripting and data injection
  attacks.
* **[Session cookies][50]**: the `Secure`, `HttpOnly`, and `SameSite` attributes on cookies prevent
  interception, script access, and cross-site request forgery.
* **[Authentication][51]**: HTTP defines challenge-response authentication through
  `WWW-Authenticate` and `Authorization` headers. Token-based schemes like Bearer tokens and API
  keys build on this foundation.

# HyperText Transfer Protocol (HTTP)

HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) is the foundation of data exchange on the web. Every web page,
API call, image, stylesheet, and script reaches its destination through HTTP. Clients send requests
to servers, servers return responses, and intermediaries like proxies and CDNs relay messages
between them.

HTTP is part of the internet protocol suite alongside DNS, TLS, and TCP.

This page was delivered over HTTP

Every web page, including this one, reaches the browser through an HTTP request and response.

## How HTTP works

HTTP follows a request-response model. A client sends a request specifying an [HTTP method][7] (the
action), a [URL][8] (the resource), and [Headers][9] (metadata). The server processes the request
and returns a response with a [status code][10] (the outcome), headers, and an optional body
containing the resource data.

`GET /api/products HTTP/1.1
Host: www.example.re
Accept: application/json
`

`HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 512

{"products":[...]}
`

HTTP is [stateless by design][11]: each request is self-contained and independent. [Cookies][12] and
[tokens][13] maintain state across exchanges when needed.

## HTTP versions

The [original HTTP specification][14] dates to the early 1990s with a single-line protocol
supporting only [GET][15] requests. Each subsequent version addressed the performance and security
limitations of its predecessor.
* **[HTTP/1.0][16]**: added [HTTP headers][17], [HTTP status codes][18], and content types beyond
  HTML. Each request opened a new TCP connection.
* **[HTTP/1.1][19]**: made persistent [HTTP connections][20] the default, allowing multiple
  request-response exchanges over a single TCP connection.
* **[HTTP/2][21]**: introduced binary framing, multiplexing, and header [Compression][22]. Multiple
  HTTP requests and HTTP responses flow concurrently over one connection.
* **[HTTP/3][23]**: replaced TCP with [QUIC][24], a UDP-based transport with built-in encryption
  eliminating head-of-line blocking.

## Core components

HTTP relies on three core building blocks working together in every exchange:
* **[HTTP headers][25]**: name-value pairs carrying metadata about the message, the client, and the
  server. Headers control [HTTP caching][26], [Authentication][27], [Compression][28], [content
  negotiation][29], [session state][30], and security policy.
* **[HTTP methods][31]**: verbs defining the action on a resource. [GET][32] retrieves, [POST][33]
  submits, [PUT][34] replaces, [DELETE][35] removes. Each method carries safety, idempotency, and
  [cacheability][36] properties.
* **[HTTP status codes][37]**: three-digit numbers in the response indicating the outcome. [1xx][38]
  informational, [2xx][39] success, [3xx][40] [redirection][41], [4xx][42] client error, [5xx][43]
  server error.

## Security

Plain HTTP transmits data in cleartext. [HTTPS][44] layers HTTP over TLS, encrypting the exchange
and providing confidentiality, integrity, and server authentication. [HSTS][45] enforces [HTTPS][46]
for all future connections to a host. Modern browsers mark plain HTTP pages as insecure and restrict
sensitive APIs to secure contexts.

To coordinate between clients, servers, and intermediaries, HTTP relies on:
* **[CORS][47]**: controls which [origins][48] are permitted to read responses from a different
  origin. Servers declare allowed origins, methods, and headers through response headers.
* **[Content Security Policy (CSP)][49]**: restricts the sources a page loads scripts, styles,
  images, and other resources from. A strong CSP blocks cross-site scripting and data injection
  attacks.
* **[Session cookies][50]**: the `Secure`, `HttpOnly`, and `SameSite` attributes on cookies prevent
  interception, script access, and cross-site request forgery.
* **[Authentication][51]**: HTTP defines challenge-response authentication through
  `WWW-Authenticate` and `Authorization` headers. Token-based schemes like Bearer tokens and API
  keys build on this foundation.

## What does IFFO do?


**IFFO is an international membership organisation that represents the marine ingredients industry,
such as fishmeal, fish oil and other related industries. IFFO’s 250 members, who’ve joined on a
voluntary basis, reside in around 50 countries, and account for over 50% of world production and 75%
of the fishmeal and fish oil traded worldwide.**

We lead the responsible development of marine ingredients by working to:
* Progress the industry
* Provide a meeting point
* Be the main source of information
* Ensure that the vital role of sustainable marine ingredients in the global food system is
  recognised

## Fishmeal and fish oil's role in the Blue Transformation


UN FAO’s work on aquatic food systems for the period 2022–2030 is outlined in its Blue
Transformation Roadmap, built on three core components: Effective management of all fisheries ;
sustainable aquaculture expansion ; and upgraded value chains.

With aquaculture growing, more feed materials are needed. What role will the marine ingredients
value chain play in improving fisheries, enabling better retention of nutrients within food systems
and formulating feed strategies which support the fish's health and development while mitigating the
feed's environmental impacts?

## About

Founded in 1922, Lard Oil Company’s mission is to be the premier petroleum marketer in the region.
For over 100 years, our company has continued to grow and expand. We now have over 500 employees, 20
convenience stores, and 9 bulk plants.

Our central office is located in Denham Springs, Louisiana, allowing for a wider distribution area
throughout the region. We are proud to be the largest ExxonMobil distributor in Louisiana and
Mississippi, and we provide 24/7 delivery service to stations, quick lubes, and other commercial and
industrial businesses.

## About

Founded in 1922, Lard Oil Company’s mission is to be the premier petroleum marketer in the region.
For over 100 years, our company has continued to grow and expand. We now have over 500 employees, 20
convenience stores, and 9 bulk plants.

Our central office is located in Denham Springs, Louisiana, allowing for a wider distribution area
throughout the region. We are proud to be the largest ExxonMobil distributor in Louisiana and
Mississippi, and we provide 24/7 delivery service to stations, quick lubes, and other commercial and
industrial businesses.

## The world's leading fish oil producer from Iceland

LYSI is a reliable producer of fish oils that improve health and quality of life.

[Bulk products][26][Consumer products][27]

### The company

LYSI is an Icelandic producer distributing health products all over the world. LYSI‘s dedicated and
passionate team works hard to provide the best quality products and services to our customers.

[Download our brochure][28]

### Iceland’s secret to healthy living

The principal product is LYSI's Cod Liver Oil. In addition, a selection of health supplement
products are available under the LYSI brand and private labels.

[Consumer Products][29]
[Consumer Products][30]

### High quality fish oils in bulk

LYSI's refinery is equipped with highly specialised processing equipment necessary for the
production of high quality fish oil. This enables LYSI to offer a wide range of products that meet
customers' requirements for quality and flexibility.

[Bulk products][31]
[Bulk products][32]

## Certifications

Whether it be consumer or bulk products, our certifications and 80+ years of experience mean that
you can buy with confidence.

### FSSC 22000

An internationally recognised food safety management standard based on ISO 22000 and recognised by
the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI).

### GMP

A standard for minimising risks in pharmaceutical production that must be complied with by medicinal
manufacturers.

### Halal

A guarantee that products meet the requirements of Islamic law and are therefore suitable for
consumption by the Muslim population.

### FOS

A project of the World Sustainability Organization to assure the public that fish products come from
responsibly and sustainably managed fisheries.

### Operating since 1938

LYSI's story began in 1938 with two ambitious brothers, Tryggvi and Thordur Olafsson, who had a
vision to create Iceland's largest cod liver oil producer – a title the company still holds today.

In the beginning, LYSI only exported products in bulk, then in the 1950‘s the company started
producing cod liver oil in consumer packaging. Since 2005 LYSI has produced its fish oils in a brand
new and uniquely equipped processing plant in Reykjavik with 13,000 tons capacity.

Today LYSI is known all over the world for its expertise on fish oils, high quality products and
outstanding services, skills which have been accumulated for over 85 years.

[Read the story][33]

## The world's leading fish oil producer from Iceland

LYSI is a reliable producer of fish oils that improve health and quality of life.

[Bulk products][26][Consumer products][27]

### The company

LYSI is an Icelandic producer distributing health products all over the world. LYSI‘s dedicated and
passionate team works hard to provide the best quality products and services to our customers.

[Download our brochure][28]

### Iceland’s secret to healthy living

The principal product is LYSI's Cod Liver Oil. In addition, a selection of health supplement
products are available under the LYSI brand and private labels.

[Consumer Products][29]
[Consumer Products][30]

### High quality fish oils in bulk

LYSI's refinery is equipped with highly specialised processing equipment necessary for the
production of high quality fish oil. This enables LYSI to offer a wide range of products that meet
customers' requirements for quality and flexibility.

[Bulk products][31]
[Bulk products][32]

## Certifications

Whether it be consumer or bulk products, our certifications and 80+ years of experience mean that
you can buy with confidence.

### FSSC 22000

An internationally recognised food safety management standard based on ISO 22000 and recognised by
the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI).

### GMP

A standard for minimising risks in pharmaceutical production that must be complied with by medicinal
manufacturers.

### Halal

A guarantee that products meet the requirements of Islamic law and are therefore suitable for
consumption by the Muslim population.

### FOS

A project of the World Sustainability Organization to assure the public that fish products come from
responsibly and sustainably managed fisheries.

### Operating since 1938

LYSI's story began in 1938 with two ambitious brothers, Tryggvi and Thordur Olafsson, who had a
vision to create Iceland's largest cod liver oil producer – a title the company still holds today.

In the beginning, LYSI only exported products in bulk, then in the 1950‘s the company started
producing cod liver oil in consumer packaging. Since 2005 LYSI has produced its fish oils in a brand
new and uniquely equipped processing plant in Reykjavik with 13,000 tons capacity.

Today LYSI is known all over the world for its expertise on fish oils, high quality products and
outstanding services, skills which have been accumulated for over 85 years.

[Read the story][33]

## Hi Sweet Friends

***Welcome to Mary’s Nest Cooking School.*** Do you want to be a Modern Pioneer in the Kitchen and
be part of the Traditional Foods Movement? If so, you’ve found a home! I’m Mary Bryant Shrader, and
I teach *Traditional Cooking Skills*, including *How to Cook from Scratch*, so you can make
“Nutrient Dense” Foods, including Bone Broths, Cultured Dairy, Ferments, Sourdough Starter,
Sourdough Bread, and More!

I’m so glad you’re here!

## Bone Broth Recipes

Learn how to make different varieties of bone broth, including beef, chicken, pork, and fish.

[See all →][84]
[][85]

### [How to Make Chicken Bone Broth for Pennies a Jar][86]

Make delicious and nutritious Roast Chicken Bone Broth for Pennies a Jar…And discover the secret
ingredient to making the best broth ever!

[[A pot of vegetables and bones cooking in a pot to make beef bone broth.][A pot of vegetables and
bones cooking in a pot to make beef bone broth.]][87]

### [How to Make Rich and Gelatinous Beef Bone Broth][88]

Discover which are the best bones to use to make the most gelatinous beef bone broth!

[][89]

### [What is the Difference Between Broth, Stock, and Bone Broth?][90]

Learn the difference between these three nutritious liquids.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Leap of Faith

Southern rockhopper penguins (Eudyptes chrysocome) navigate the rocky cliffs and crashing waves on
Marion Island, one of two Prince Edward Islands off the coast of South Africa. The penguins are
characterized by the spiky black-and-yellow feathers on their heads. They typically hop rather than
waddle along the rugged shorelines of islands north of Antarctica, which is how they got their name.

  crushings as well as ample supplies of oilmeals. This will be reflected in deviating price trends,

  since 2024 - is likely to continue in 2026/27.

  within 10 years...

  #### Uneven Distribution of Consumption Growth
  
  **Biofuel-driven boom contrasting with price-driven rationing elsewhere....**

  range from ambitious biofuel mandates to state intervention in production and exports, like e.g.
  in the Indonesian palm oil sector. Furthermore, the conflict in the Middle East has improved the
  competitiveness of vegetable oils in the energy market but at the same time it is raising
  production and transportation costs...

  uptrend of demand in some countries will partly come at the expense of consumers in
  price-sensitive markets....Rising domestic use in key producing countries will tighten export
  supplies. World exports of eight vegetable oils are estimated to decline by 1.5 Mn T on the year

  #### EU Oilseed Crushings Forecast to Rise by 0.6 Mn T or 1% in 2026/27
  
  Sunflowerseed crushings are seen rebounding in 2026/27 and are forecast to reach a 3-year high of
  8.5 Mn T, with biggest gains in Romania, France, Hungary and Bulgaria... 
  
  We anticipate rapeseed crushings in the EU to virtually stagnate at around 26.3 Mn T in 2026/27.
  Imports are set to decline, primarily from Canada and Australia.... Soybean crushings will
  probably also stagnate next season at the reduced level of 14.9 Mn T likely to be registered in
  2025/26....
  
  [read more][6]
* ## PRICES
  
  ### Monthly Averages
  
  #### US Soya Oil Price Rally Reversed by Demand Shifts
  
  The huge price premiums for US soya oil developing in May, June and early July as a result of
  skyrocketing demand from US biofuel producers have triggered a shift of demand to other feedstock.
  The arbitrage has promoted rising US usage and/or higher imports of corn oil, animal fats and
  UCO.... We have updated our monthly average prices for oils & fats until June...
  
   
  
  [read more][7]
* ## BIODIESEL
  
  ### WEEKLY June 26
  
  #### World Biodiesel Production May Increase by 6.7 Mn T in 2026
  
  Biofuels likely to account for 22% of world consumption of oils & fats in 2025/26.
  
  Combined world production of biodiesel and HVO is tentatively estimated at 69.5 Mn T in Jan/Dec
  2026. Following a setback by 1.9 Mn T in 2025, production is seen increasing by as much as 6.7 Mn
  T this year. The reversal of the production trend is occurring primarily in the USA where the
  delayed release of policy guidelines had resulted in a reduction of biodiesel/HVO production by
  2.8 Mn T in 2025. The release of ambitious admixture mandates early this year has triggered a
  sharp increase and may lift output of biodiesel and HVO in the USA to a new high ....
  
  Usage of 17 oils and fats for biofuel production is seen increasing to an estimated 59.3 Mn T in
  Oct/Sept 2025/26 (excluding UCO). This raises the share absorbed by the energy market to a new
  high of 22%. By country estimates in the WEEKLY...
  
  [read more][8]
* ## ANNUAL 2026
  
  ### June 2026
  
  #### Order Your OIL WORLD Annual 2026 NOW
  
  **Fundamentals Point to Increasing Vegetable Oil Prices in 2026/27**
                                  
  The stage is set for a bullish price outlook for vegetable oils in the next 12 months. Prospects
  point to a global production deficit of 17 oils & fats as well as to inevitable demand rationing
  and higher prices. Our 2026/27 supply & demand forecasts of oilseeds, oils & fats and oilmeals -
  prepared in early June 2026 - point to tightness developing for oils & fats worldwide and higher
  prices, rising dependence on seed oils and a resulting further sizable increase in oilseed
  crushings as well as ample supplies of oilmeals. This will be reflected in deviating price trends,
  with additional upward momentum for vegetable oils and downward pressure on oilmeals. Seed oils
  will have to finance an even larger share of the crush margin next season, pushing the oil share
  even higher. The relative strength of oil & fat prices relative to oilmeals – already ongoing
  since 2024 - is likely to continue in 2026/27. 
  
  For producers and consumers alike the global markets will again provide great challenges and
  opportunities this year. To take advantage of them you require the independent and competent
  information and forecasts we are providing in this unique compendium.
  
  In the 2026 issue of the OIL WORLD ANNUAL we analyse all the important price-making factors and
  publish our first 2026/27 projections for each of the 10 oilseeds, 17 oils & fats and 12 oilmeals.
  The ANNUAL focusses also on demand for vegetable oils and animal fats  as a feedstock for biofuel
  production and its impact on the total global demand, trade and prices of oils and fats as well as
  the repercussions on oilseeds and oilmeals. This includes world production of biodiesel (with
  breakdown by country) as well as biodiesel imports and exports of major countries. More details in
  the just released OIL WORLD Annual 2026....
  
  [read more][9]
* ## OILSEEDS
  
  ### WEEKLY June 12
  
  #### Soybean Crush Up 95 Mn T in 10 Years
  
  Under the lead of soybeans, world oilseed crushings will rise sharply for the third consecutive
  year to about 580.0 Mn T in Oct/Sept 2025/26, representing an increase of 65 Mn T within three
  years. The global dependence on soybeans has accelerated since 2023/24, while the growth in other
  oilseeds fell back, mainly owing to weather-caused production losses in some major sunflowerseed
  and rapeseed producing regions.
  
  We estimate world crushings of soybeans at 372.3 Mn T in Oct/Sept 2025/26. This is 11.2 Mn T above
  last season and brings the combined increase within three years to a staggering 56.1 Mn T. The
  increase has taken place primarily in China as well as in the USA, Brazil and Argentina. In
  2015/16, soybean processing amounted to 277 Mn T, implying a significant increase of 95 Mn T
  within 10 years...
  
  [read more][10]
* ## 8 OILS
  
  ### MONTHLY May 22
  
  #### Uneven Distribution of Consumption Growth
  
  **Biofuel-driven boom contrasting with price-driven rationing elsewhere....**
  
  Political parameters are strongly affecting vegetable oil markets this season. The interferences
  range from ambitious biofuel mandates to state intervention in production and exports, like e.g.
  in the Indonesian palm oil sector. Furthermore, the conflict in the Middle East has improved the
  competitiveness of vegetable oils in the energy market but at the same time it is raising
  production and transportation costs...
  
  A two-tiered development of vegetable oil consumption is thus shaping up: The politically-driven
  uptrend of demand in some countries will partly come at the expense of consumers in
  price-sensitive markets....Rising domestic use in key producing countries will tighten export
  supplies. World exports of eight vegetable oils are estimated to decline by 1.5 Mn T on the year
  in April/Sept 2026...Latest OIL WORLD supply and demand estimates in the MONTHLY...
  
  [read more][11]
* ## 7 OILSEEDS
  
  ### MONTHLY May 22
  
  #### World Oilseed Supplies Seen Increasing by 24 Mn T in 2025/26
  
  World production of 7 oilseeds is turning out higher than previously expected in the 2025/26
  season. We have made an upward revision by 3.3 Mn T from a month earlier and now estimate world
  production at 675.3 Mn T, 14.5 Mn T above a year earlier....
  
  World consumption of oilseeds will continue to grow sizably and is expected to be up by 23.3 Mn T
  this season, driven by sharply increasing crushings of soybeans and rapeseed. . Latest OIL WORLD
  supply and demand estimates for all 7 major oilseeds in the MONTHLY report....
  
  [read more][12]
